test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

In August, she will be / enjoying / all the fruits her grandmother / will plant last January.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the future tense "**will plant**" for an action that took place in the past.
 
• The correct tense should be the past perfect "**had planted**" to indicate that the action was completed before another action in the past.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**had planted last January**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"In August, she will be enjoying all the fruits her grandmother **had planted** last January."*
